items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I remember playing out there with a fellow by name, uh, Early. Played bass. ... Tom Early, yes.

ctx.x: Who did you play with out there? Do you remember?

Um, well, uh, pick up bands, Dick. Nothing in particular. You know in those days, somebody called you up for a job. You never cared. You didn't much care, no matter who it was. It was just the idea that you had a, you were going to play out at a picnic. And you didn't pay much attention to really who it was. Uh, I remember playing out there with a fellow by name, uh, Early. Played bass. Have you ever taught him that name? Tom Early, yes.
